Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Plunging Attack

abilities.name: Razorgrass Blade
_curatorNotes: Skill: single Dendro hit at skillHitmark=28f, 414.72% ATK Dendro at lvl=10. Wide 130° fan-angle. 2-3 Dendro particles per cast (50% chance for 3, 0.3s ICD).
Frames: skillFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(37), ActionDash/Jump=29 ActionSwap=36. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J — N/Q default to animLen=37.
abilities.description: Whirling the discarded sword to its limit, the Traveler unleashes 1 final stroke that deals AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of them.

abilities.name: Surgent Manifestation
_curatorNotes: Burst spawns LeaLotus Lamp at burstHitmark=91f from cast (leaLotusAppear=54f after cast + initial damage at 91f). 12s duration. Per-tick burstTick[lvl=10]=144.29% ATK Dendro at 1.5s intervals.

Authored as summons[] entry with summonTick effect: interval 1.5s (gcsim ThinkInterval=90f), firstTickDelay 0 (first damage at 91f coincides with spawnsAt=91). A1/C6 EM buff ticks run separately at 0.3s (not the damage cadence).
A6 rigor 2026-07-12: summonTick interval corrected 1 → 1.5 and firstTickDelay 1 → 0 (gcsim lealotus.go: ThinkInterval=90f=1.5s; first damage at burstHitmark=91f = spawnsAt, so 0 delay).
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(58), ActionSwap=57. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — N/E/D/J default to animLen=58.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 1200f=20s). EnergyMax=80. ConsumeEnergy(2) drains 2 energy from teammates.

A1 (Lush Reaches): LeaLotus accumulates 1 stack per second on Lamp (max 12). On burst end, explodes for burstExplode[lvl] × stacks. A1 stack accumulation + on-end explosion not authored — no trigger primitive for 'on-summon-end-with-stack-multiplier'.
C6 (Hopeful Inheritance): A1 buff +30 EM to active party member during Lamp duration. Not authored — A1 stack mechanic deferred.
abilities.description: Forming a LeaLotus Lamp, the Traveler deals AoE Dendro DMG to opponents and uses the LeaLotus Lamp to deal continuous Dendro DMG to opponents within an AoE for the duration.

passives.name: Lush Reaches
_curatorNotes: A1: LeaLotus Lamp accumulates 1 stack/s while burst is active (max 12). On burst end, the Lamp explodes for burstExplode multiplier × stacks. No 'on-summon-end with stack multiplier' trigger primitive in schema — not authored.
passives.description: When the Lamp is on the field, it accumulates Lamp Spirit, gaining 1 Lamp Spirit per second. When the Lamp is on the field for the maximum duration, the Lamp will detonate, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.

passives.name: Verdant Overgrowth
_curatorNotes: A4: when the LeaLotus Lamp triggers Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Bloom, +30% EM to the triggering character. Not authored — reaction-event-trigger gated on summon source not expressible.
passives.description: When the Lamp triggers Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Bloom, party members within 12s gain +30% Elemental Mastery.
